description: xp-plugin SessionStart: inject the process and print the recover command.

hooks.command: r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -f "$r/scripts/xp.py" ] || r=$(ls -d "$(dirname "$r")"/[0-9]*/ 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); [ -f "${r%/}/scripts/xp.py" ] || { echo "xp-plugin: no scripts/xp.py under ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} or a sibling version" >&2; exit 0; }; exec python3 "${r%/}/scripts/xp.py" session-start
